Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KV IIT Ropar Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the KV IIT Ropar recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the KV IIT Ropar recruitment is Primary Teacher (PRT). This is a contractual position for the academic session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 28 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Primary Teacher post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Senior Secondary (+2) with at least 50% marks and possess a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) or a 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any desirable qualification mentioned?
faq.answer: Yes, proficiency in teaching Hindi and English, knowledge of computer applications, and CTET Paper 1 qualification are desirable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Primary Teacher post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 21250/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Primary Teacher post?
faq.answer: As per the notification, there are 0 vacancies available for the Primary Teacher post.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents, a latest passport-size photograph, and self-attested copies of all relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Kendriya Vidyalaya IIT Ropar located?
faq.answer: Kendriya Vidyalaya IIT Ropar is located in Ropar, Punjab.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
